title: Sun Bliss | Stunning Infinity Pool & Ocean Views
description: Please be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!The spaceSun Bliss is a 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom private oceanview retreat in Aguada, comfortably sleeping up to 6 guests. This single-level home is surrounded by lush tropical vegetation, expansive green spaces, and sweeping ocean views, offering the perfect balance of privacy, comfort, and natural beauty.Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the home with natural light and seamlessly bring the outdoors in. The property is fully air-conditioned and thoughtfully designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living.Outside, enjoy your own private oasis featuring an infinity pool overlooking the ocean, a private basketball court, and ample space to relax and unwind. The property also includes parking for up to 4 cars.Located in the charming coastal town of Aguada, between Rincón and Aguadilla, Sun Bliss offers a peaceful escape close to beautiful beaches, local dining, and a more relaxed island experience.HEADS UP: THIS LISTING IS LOCATED WITHIN A PROPERTY THAT SHARES A COMMON ROAD ENTRANCE WITH ANOTHER HOME, WHICH WE ALSO MANAGE. EACH RESIDENCE HAS ITS OWN PRIVATE DRIVEWAY, AND THE LAYOUT ENSURES PRIVACY AT ALL TIMES, ALLOWING GUESTS TO ENJOY A COMFORTABLE AND INDEPENDENT STAY. IF YOU ARE A LARGER GROUP AND WOULD LIKE TO BOOK BOTH, PLEASE LET US KNOW AND WE CAN SEND YOU THE LINK TO THE OTHER UNIT: COASTAL BLISS.PROPERTY'S HIGHLIGHTS- Equipped with a backup generator and water tank.- Private infinity pool- Ocean Views- Basketball Court- High speed wifi- Washer & Dryer for added convenience- Parking for up to 4 cars- 3 king bedsLIVING AREAUpon entering Sun Bliss, you are welcomed by a bright and spacious open-concept floor plan that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the entire space, showcasing breathtaking views of lush greenery and the ocean while filling the home with natural light.The living area features an expansive, ultra-comfortable U-shaped sofa and a flat-screen TV, creating the perfect space to relax and unwind.The dining area sits just beyond the living space, perfectly positioned to enjoy the surrounding views and indoor-outdoor flow of the homeKITCHENThe fully equipped kitchen includes everything you need for an extended stay. It offers modern appliances, cookware, utensils, and all essentials for preparing meals with ease. Designed for both convenience and functionality, it is ideal for families or groups who enjoy cooking at home while traveling. It’s stocked for all your cooking needs, featuring a fridge, ffreezer, microwave, toaster, stovetop, accessories, and a coffee maker (note: no oven).SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSEach of the three well-appointed bedrooms features a king-size bed, blackout curtains, and a flat-screen TV. The master bedroom includes a private en-suite bathroom, while a second full bathroom is conveniently located in the hallway.PACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability.GETTING AROUND & PARKINGA car is necessary to explore Aguada and its beaches. Sun Bliss offers excellent parking with a covered 2-car garage and an additional driveway for up to 2 more vehicles.LOCATIONAguada shares a coastline with Aguadilla and Rincón, known for stunning beaches. Highlights include:Balneario Pico de Piedra (Aguada): Ideal for swimming and family outings.Rompeolas and Crashboat Beach (Aguadilla): Offers some of the clearest water along the northwest coast of Puerto Rico, with gorgeous shades of turquoise.Sandy and Maria’s Beach (Rincón): These are a favorite among the surfers, where several surfing instructors take visitors to learn to surf. You can rent surfing equipment on site.Domes Beach:(Rincón): Also known as Lighthouse Beach. Great surfing action all year, a popular spot to watch the sunset and for loungers wishing to enjoy the sound of the waves. The PR-115 road leads to Pico de Piedra beach, branching off to Rincón and Aguada. Along this route, explore numerous oceanfront restaurants and bars. Don’t miss La Cruz de Colón, marking Columbus's disembarkation in 1493.Nearby attractions include:Aguada Pyramid: A hidden gem inspired by Mayan architecture.Salto Atalaya: A beautiful waterfall with natural swimming pools.Hacienda Jeanmarie Chocolate: A cacao farm offering weekend tours.Guaniquilla Coast: A family-friendly area with sculptures, restaurants, and stunning beaches.Central Coloso: An abandoned sugar mill reflecting Puerto Rico's 19th-century sugar industry.PLACES TO EAT-El Galeón Restaurant: Beachfront, family-friendly seafood and meats.-Waves Seafood Restaurant: Oceanfront seafood dining.-Cava Baja: A mix of international and Puerto Rican cuisine.-The Island Bar & Restaurant: Cozy with a sea view, serving local dishes.-Me "Latte" un Capricho: Creative breakfast spot.Other things to noteSTARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish sponge- A small amount of laundry detergentPlease note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 6 adults/children at all times, including visitors. OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.

description: This newly constructed family home is in the La Joya neighborhood, just above the famous Tres Palmas Marine Reserve and only a 5 min drive to the plaza. Both world class surfing and snorkeling are within walking distance. The land is filled with local fruit trees and horses are almost always within view from the porch. It’s an ideal location for those seeking a quiet and peaceful place but still close to everything. This is a private residential neighborhood - no parties or events. 40 mbps WiFiThe spaceThis large ranch-style house is located on 1 acre of peacefully secluded land. The spacious wrap around porch offers a private space to BBQ and eat at a large outdoor dining area or just lounge in a hammock, eat, read, and relax. Inside, each of the three bedrooms and main area of the house have individual ACs. 40 mbps of satellite internet will keep you connected for remote work and offers streaming entertainment on the flat screen television. Mango, breadfruit, banana, starfruit and avocados can be found right on the property when in season. Local farmer's markets on Wednesday evenings and Sundays are 5 minutes away. The modern kitchen has plenty of prep area and comfortable seating for guests who love to cook at home. Beach chairs and beach towels are available and surfboard rentals are available in every direction on the 413. Tranquil, cozy, and tucked away without being more than 5 minutes of all town highlights - beaches, surfing, restaurants, walking trails - great for families - Casa Azul La Joya makes it easy to be as active or quiet as you want, while surrounded by tropical beauty.Guest accessThe house is rented as a 3-bedroom, the garage is currently closed off. Guests have access to the entire house otherwise.

description: Located in an intimate setting on the hillside of Rincón, this property offers privacy with an incredible saltwater pool which is perfect for viewing the famous sunsets every night of the year.We respect diversity and inclusion. We welcome guests of all races, faiths, genders, and sexual orientations. We look forward to welcoming you to Casa Puesta Del Sol and introducing you to our beautiful City of Rincón. Start planning your next island getaway now and save your dates today!The spaceRelax at this private home, with stunning views of Desecheo Island, only 35 minutes from the Rafael Hernández Airport (BQN) in Aguadilla or 2.5 hours from the Luiz Munoz airport (SJU) in San Juan. Almendro’s Beach is a short 5-minute drive and is a great swimming beach for the whole family or for those sunset walks. Also, within a 5-minute drive are the necessary grocery stores, gyms, gas stations, and restaurants. Come enjoy the surfing capital of the Caribbean with world-class surfing at Dogman’s, Domes, Sandy, Steps, and Maria's Beach. All of which are within a 10-minute drive. The house has air conditioning in all bedrooms. The spacious primary bedroom and bathroom suite has a king-size bed with a walk-in closet, double sinks, a shower, and exterior doors that lead to the patio and pool area. The 2nd bedroom has a king-size bed, and the 3rd bedroom has a queen-size bed. The 4th bedroom also has a queen size bed and exterior doors that lead to the patio and pool area. The house comfortably sleeps 8 people but can accommodate up to 10 people for an extra fee with the sleeper sofa in the living room. This is an ideal property for extended families and friends traveling together. The saltwater pool is one of the largest private pools in Rincón!The kitchen is fully equipped with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, microwave, wine fridge, toaster oven, coffee maker, Keurig machine, mocha pot, pots and pans, cups, plates, utensils, and other comforts of any home. The home is in excellent condition and has public water and power. In case of emergency, the house has a backup generator in the event of a power outage and reserve water in the cistern in case of a water outage. The property is fully fenced-in. This spacious house comes fully equipped with snorkeling sets, beach chairs, cooler, sun umbrellas, beach towels, BBQ grill, pool and kids’ toys, air conditioning, washer & dryer, games, Wi-Fi, and two 55” Smart TVs. The saltwater pool is perfect for accommodating the entire family for a pool day or full moon swim as it is 13' by 36' wide and 4'-8' deep. The dedicated pool deck stays cool to the touch even during the hottest of Caribbean sunny days because of the Corallina tile. Fall asleep on a lounge chair by the pool, while listening to the sound of birds and Puerto Rico’s famous Coqui frogs. Enjoy barbequing with friends and family on the patio and enjoy the outside dining table for dining alfresco while you enjoy the sunset sky. Head out to the many local restaurants and bars within a short driving distance such as Bakku, Pa’l Monte, Parrilleria Vacas Gauchas, Gastropark@115, Ricomini Bakery, and Tip Top Ice Cream.Other things to noteNo parties or events allowed.We are pet friendly.
